prompt: Create a stepped shaft named `shaft` along the X axis, starting at x=0: 40 mm long with 30 mm diameter, followed by 60 mm with 20 mm diameter, followed by 25 mm with 12 mm diameter. The shaft must be a single solid.
solution: shaft: Cylinder(O, ax 40*EX, 30) | Cylinder(40*EX, ax 60*EX, 20) | Cylinder(100*EX, ax 25*EX, 12);
